'''Wayfar''' was a settlement on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Geographically, it was located in the deep south of the most inhabitable region of Tatooine, east of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].

==History==
Found past the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], and neighbor to the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]], Wayfar could barely be called a [[City/Legends|town]]. Were it not for the fact that some [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] found the town appealing, Wayfar would have been nothing more than an abandoned settlement. It was also not uncommon to see hermits visit the town occasionally for much needed supplies.<ref name="SWG:W">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Wayfar|Tatooine}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Kaimer]] was the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Wayfar. At about the same time the [[Escape from Tatooine|hunt]] for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] was underway on Tatooine, Wayfar was the site of a [[Battle of Wayfar|battle]] between local farmers and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] who wished to claim the town's water supplies for their own; the Tuskens were defeated with the aid of a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].<ref name="GG1" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Porgryn]] of the [[Azure Cabal]] operated out of this town. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], Wayfar chose to host a [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration. During the celebration, a very rare snow blizzard covered the town in snow.<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wayfar map.jpg|250px|thumb|A map of Wayfar]]
In the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Wayfar is one of many cities on Tatooine. When the game was first released, the town lacked a shuttleport. This forced players to walk or drive to Wayfar from another city. However, the developers eventually added a shuttleport to the town to make transportation to Wayfar more convenient.<ref name="SWG" />

During the Life Day live event from [[December 16]], [[2008]] to [[January 12]], [[2009]], players could visit Wayfar for a variety of Life Day activities. For the event, Wayfar had a blizzard which covered the town in snow.<ref name="SWG:NGE" /> It is unclear how this could be viewed from an in-universe perspective.
